roots.origin: 拉丁语 serere（把东西一个接一个编连起来，如串珠、编篱），过去分词 sertus；series（系列）同根
roots.core_concept: to join things one after another in a line / 一个接一个串连成列
roots.core_image: 一根线把珠子一颗接一颗串起来，中间断一颗整串就散
roots.english_definition: to join, link in a row

roots.origin: 拉丁语 habere（持有、拿住、保持某状态）；复合词里元音弱化成 -hibēre，故拼作 -hibit（habit/inhabit 亦同源，已另立 habitare 族）
roots.core_concept: to hold a thing and decide whether it is let out / 手里拿住，并决定放不放出去
roots.core_image: 一只手把东西攥着：张开给人看，或收拢不许动

roots.origin: 拉丁语 manus（手）；manuālis（手上的）、manuārius 及意大利语 maneggiare（驯马、经手打理）都由此出
roots.core_concept: the hand that takes hold and works a thing / 一双上手打理事物的手
roots.core_image: 一双手把缰绳收在掌里，一收一放都由这双手定

roots.origin: 拉丁语 struere（一层层垒起来）的过去分词 structus；instruere 本义是「把材料备齐垒上」，引申为教导
roots.core_concept: to pile layer on layer into a standing whole / 一层层垒起来，成为立得住的整体
roots.core_image: 砖一层压一层垒上去，垒到最后自己立得稳

roots.origin: 拉丁语 spatium（跨开的距离、场地、一段时间），原与「迈步跨开」相关
roots.core_concept: the gap opened up between things / 物与物之间撑开的那段距离
roots.core_image: 两手向左右撑开，中间空出一段谁也不占的距离

roots.origin: 拉丁语 stringere（拉紧、束紧），过去分词 strictus；strict（严格）、string（弦）同根
roots.core_concept: to draw a cord tight so movement is checked / 把绳收紧，使动弹不得
roots.core_image: 绳子越收越紧，勒在物上，想动也动不了多少

concepts.concept: to join things one after another in a line
concepts.core_image: 线上珠子一颗接一颗，抽掉一颗整串就散

concepts.concept: to hold a thing and decide whether to let it out
concepts.core_image: 手攥着一物，张开是给人看，收拢是不许动

concepts.concept: the hand that takes hold and works a thing
concepts.core_image: 缰绳收在掌里，一收一放都由这双手定

concepts.concept: to pile layer on layer into a standing whole
concepts.core_image: 砖一层压一层垒上去，垒稳了自己立得住

concepts.concept: the gap opened up between things
concepts.core_image: 两手左右撑开，中间空出一段谁也不占的地方

concepts.concept: to draw a cord tight so movement is checked
concepts.core_image: 绳子越收越紧勒在物上，想动也动不了多少

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 靠向）+ sert（串连）→ 把话一句扣一句地接稳 → 断言
words.origin: 拉丁语 asserere（宣称、主张），来自 ad＋serere（连上）
words.native_definition: to state something firmly as true; to make others recognize a right
words.core_concept: linking one's words tight to a claim and standing on it – 把话紧扣在主张上，站定不退
words.core_image: 他把三条依据一条接一条摆上桌，语气不留退路
examples: She asserted that the data was sound.
He asserted his right to speak.
semantic_expansions: 断言/声称：把话紧扣在主张上说定
维护：把自己的权利扣住不放
words.recall_hint: as-（靠向）+ sert（串连）→ 把话扣紧在主张上

words.root_logic: de-（脱开）+ sert（串连）→ 把串连解开、撇下不管 → 抛弃
words.origin: 拉丁语 deserere（解开连结、弃置），来自 de＋serere；与甜品 dessert（法语 desservir 清桌）无关，勿混
words.native_definition: to abandon someone or something, especially a duty or post
words.core_concept: unhooking oneself from the row and walking off – 把自己从串上解开走掉
words.core_image: 队伍还在原地，他半夜把装备一扔就走了
examples: He deserted his post before dawn.
She felt deserted by her closest friends.
semantic_expansions: 抛弃/遗弃：把自己从串连中解开、撇下不管
擅离：擅自脱开本该守住的那一环
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开）+ sert（串连）→ 从串上解开走掉

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ sert（串连）→ 把一物插进串里、接进队列
words.origin: 拉丁语 inserere（插入、嵌进），来自 in＋serere
words.native_definition: to put something into something else, or between other things
words.core_concept: opening the row to let one more link take its place – 把串挑开，让一枚补进那一环
words.core_image: 把新的一颗珠子挑进线上，两边一收又是整串
examples: Insert the card into the slot.
They inserted a clause into the contract.
semantic_expansions: 插入/嵌入：把一物接进串里的那一环
刊登：把文字插进版面里
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ sert（串连）→ 插进串里补上一环

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ hibit（持有）→ 把手里的东西拿出来给人看
words.origin: 拉丁语 exhibere（拿出、呈现），来自 ex＋habere
words.native_definition: to show something publicly, or to display a quality
words.core_concept: holding a thing out where others may see it – 把攥住的东西伸出去让人看
words.core_image: 他摊开掌心，把那枚旧币举到灯下让众人看
examples: The museum will exhibit her early work.
He exhibited no sign of fear.
semantic_expansions: 展出/展示：把持有之物拿出来给人看
表现出：把内里的性质显露到外面
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ hibit（持有）→ 把手里的拿出来给人看

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ hibit（持有）→ 往回攥住不放 → 抑制
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhibere（拉住、制止），来自 in＋habere
words.native_definition: to hold back a process or feeling; to make someone self-conscious
words.core_concept: keeping the hand closed so the thing cannot come out – 手往回收，使之出不来
words.core_image: 话到嘴边又被咽了回去，掌心攥得更紧
examples: The drug inhibits the growth of bacteria.
Fear of failure inhibited her.
semantic_expansions: 抑制/阻碍：往回攥住、使发不出来
使拘束：人被这股回收之力箝住
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ hibit（持有）→ 往回攥住不放

words.root_logic: pro-（在前）+ hibit（持有）→ 伸手拦在前面不许过 → 禁止
words.origin: 拉丁语 prohibere（拦住、禁止），来自 pro＋habere
words.native_definition: to forbid something formally, especially by law
words.core_concept: an arm held out in front so none may pass – 一臂横在前头，谁也过不去
words.core_image: 门口那只手一横，牌子上写着不许带火进去
examples: The law prohibits smoking indoors.
Signs prohibit entry after dark.
semantic_expansions: 禁止/阻止：伸手拦在前面不许通行
words.recall_hint: pro-（在前）+ hibit（持有）→ 伸手横拦在前

words.root_logic: man（手）+ -age → 亲手把事牵住打理 → 经营、设法办成
words.origin: 意大利语 maneggiare（用手驯马、经手打理），来自拉丁语 manus（手）
words.native_definition: to be in charge of something; to succeed in doing something difficult
words.core_concept: keeping the reins in hand so the thing goes where one wants – 把缰绳握在手里，使其听使唤
words.core_image: 缰绳一紧一松，性子最烈的马也顺着走了
examples: She manages a team of twelve.
He managed to finish before the deadline.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把事牵在手里打理
设法完成/勉力应付：手上使力，硬把难事牵成
words.recall_hint: man（手）+ -age → 把缰绳握在手里打理

words.root_logic: man（手）+ -er → 上手做一件事的手法 → 方式；复数指待人的举止
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 manere，来自拉丁语 manuarius（手上的）← manus
words.native_definition: the way in which something is done; a person's way of behaving
words.core_concept: the particular way the hand goes about a thing – 那双手上手时的特定手法
words.core_image: 同一道菜，他下刀的手法和别人明显不同
examples: He answered in a friendly manner.
It is bad manners to interrupt.
semantic_expansions: 方式：上手做事的那套手法
举止/礼貌：待人时手上与身上的分寸
words.recall_hint: man（手）+ -er → 上手做事的那套手法

words.root_logic: manu（手）+ -al（…的）→ 靠手做的；名词指握在手里的那本册子
words.origin: 拉丁语 manualis（手上的、便于手持的），来自 manus
words.native_definition: done with the hands rather than by machine; a book of instructions
words.core_concept: what is worked by hand, and the book held in one – 靠手来做的，以及手上拿的那本册子
words.core_image: 机器停了，几个人挽起袖子一件件搬；旁边摊着一本翻旧的册子
examples: This is manual work, not automated.
Check the manual before you start.
semantic_expansions: 手工的/体力的：靠一双手来做的
手册：可握在手里翻的那本说明
words.recall_hint: manu（手）+ -al → 靠手做的，及手持的那本册子

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把材料一并垒起来这件事，及垒成之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 constructio（构筑），来自 construere（垒建）← con＋struere
words.native_definition: the act of building something, or the thing built
words.core_concept: the piling of parts together until it stands – 各部分一并垒起、直到立住
words.core_image: 脚手架一层层往上升，砖也一层层压上去
examples: The bridge is still under construction.
It is a steel construction.
semantic_expansions: 建造：把材料一并垒起的过程
建筑物/结构：垒起来立住的那个整体
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 一并垒起、立成整体

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把垒起来的一层层拆掉推倒
words.origin: 拉丁语 destructio（拆毁），来自 destruere（拆垒）← de＋struere
words.native_definition: the act of ruining something completely
words.core_concept: the pile taken back down until nothing stands – 把垒起的一层层卸到什么都不剩
words.core_image: 墙体一层层往下塌，最后只余一地碎砖
examples: The storm caused widespread destruction.
War brought the destruction of the old town.
semantic_expansions: 破坏/摧毁：把垒起之物一层层卸掉推倒
毁灭：卸到什么也不剩
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把垒起的拆到不剩

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 往人心里一层层垒进去 → 教导、指示
words.origin: 拉丁语 instructio（备置、教导），来自 instruere（备齐垒上）← in＋struere
words.native_definition: teaching, or a statement telling someone what to do
words.core_concept: laying knowledge in course by course inside someone – 往人里头一层层垒进去
words.core_image: 师傅一步一步讲，学徒心里的底子一层层垒实
examples: Follow the instructions on the label.
She received instruction in music.
semantic_expansions: 指示/说明：把该怎么做一层层交代进去
教导：把学问往人心里垒实
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 往人心里一层层垒进去

words.root_logic: spatium（跨开的距离）→ 物之间空出的地方；引申为大气之外那片空阔
words.origin: 古法语 espace，来自拉丁语 spatium（距离、场地）
words.native_definition: an empty area available for use; the region beyond the earth's air
words.core_concept: the emptiness left open between things – 物与物之间留着的那段空
words.core_image: 两本书之间空着一指宽，正好再塞一本进去
examples: There is space for one more chair.
The rocket vanished into space.
semantic_expansions: 空间/地方：物之间空出可用的那段
太空：大气之外那片空阔无物之处
words.recall_hint: spatium（跨开的距离）→ 物之间空出的那段

words.root_logic: space（太空）+ ship（船）→ 在那片空阔里航行的船
words.origin: 英语复合词 space＋ship，20 世纪初随航天想象出现
words.native_definition: a vehicle used for travelling beyond the earth's air
words.core_concept: a vessel that sails the open emptiness – 在那片空阔里航行的船
words.core_image: 舷窗外一片漆黑，船身静静滑过没有风的地方
examples: The spaceship docked with the station.
Children drew a spaceship on the wall.
semantic_expansions: 宇宙飞船/太空船：在那片空阔里航行的船
words.recall_hint: space（那片空阔）+ ship（船）→ 在其中航行的船

words.root_logic: spac（距离）+ -ious（多…的）→ 空出的距离足够多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 spatiosus（宽阔的），来自 spatium
words.native_definition: having plenty of room inside
words.core_concept: holding a wide gap within, nothing pressing – 内里撑得开，四下不挤
words.core_image: 推门进去，四壁离得老远，脚步声都有回响
examples: The flat is bright and spacious.
They crossed a spacious hall.
semantic_expansions: 宽敞的/广阔的：内里撑开的距离足够多
words.recall_hint: spac（距离）+ -ious（多…的）→ 内里撑得开、不挤

words.root_logic: con-（加强）+ strain（拉紧）→ 四面收紧，把人限在窄处
words.origin: 古法语 constraindre，来自拉丁语 constringere（束紧）← con＋stringere
words.native_definition: to limit someone's freedom of action; to force a course
words.core_concept: cords drawn tight on every side so only one way is left – 四面收紧，只剩一条路可走
words.core_image: 四根绳同时收紧，能挪的余地只剩一寸
examples: Tight budgets constrain our choices.
He felt constrained to agree.
semantic_expansions: 限制/约束：四面收紧、余地被勒小
强迫：紧到只剩一条路可走
words.recall_hint: con-（加强）+ strain（拉紧）→ 四面收紧、只剩一条路

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）→ 往回一拽收住 → 拦住、克制
words.origin: 古法语 restraindre，来自拉丁语 restringere（拉回束住）← re＋stringere
words.native_definition: to hold someone or something back; to keep a feeling in check
words.core_concept: pulling the cord back to check something mid-motion – 往回一拽，把正要动的收住
words.core_image: 他刚要冲上去，绳子似的一只手把他往后一带
examples: Two officers restrained the man.
She restrained her anger.
semantic_expansions: 制止/拦住：往回一拽把正动的收住
克制：把自己的情绪往回收紧
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）→ 往回拽住收停

words.root_logic: strain（拉紧）→ 被拉紧时承的那股劲，及拉过头造成的伤
words.origin: 古法语 estreindre，来自拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）
words.native_definition: force pulling on something; pressure on a person; to injure by overstretching
words.core_concept: the pull borne by a cord stretched near its limit – 绷到将断时那根绳承着的劲
words.core_image: 绳子绷得笔直，纤维吱吱作响，眼看要断
examples: The rope broke under the strain.
He strained a muscle while lifting.
semantic_expansions: 拉力/压力：被拉紧时承着的那股劲
拉伤：拉过了头、绷出来的伤
words.recall_hint: strain（拉紧）→ 绷紧时承的劲，绷过头即伤

words.root_logic: forma（形状、模子）→ 物体的外廓；引申为定下来的规范式样，及使之成形
words.origin: 古法语 forme，来自拉丁语 forma（形状、模子）
words.native_definition: the shape of something; a printed sheet with blanks to fill; to bring into shape
words.core_concept: the outline a thing settles into – 事物定下来的那个外廓
words.core_image: 泥坯在轮盘上转，手一收，边缘就定住了
examples: The lake has the form of a crescent.
Please fill in this form and sign it.
semantic_expansions: 形状/形式：事物定下来的那个外廓
表格：把要填之项定成规范式样的那张纸
words.recall_hint: forma（形状、模子）→ 定下来的外廓与式样

words.root_logic: forma（最先的）+ -er（比较）→ 两者之中在先的那个
words.origin: 中古英语 formere，来自古英语 forma（最先的）；与 forma（形状）同形，此处取「最先」一支
words.native_definition: of an earlier time; the first of two things mentioned
words.core_concept: the one standing earlier in the line of two – 两者并列时在先的那个
words.core_image: 两个名字并排写着，手指点住上面那个
examples: Her former employer wrote the reference.
Of the two routes, the former is shorter.
semantic_expansions: 以前的/前者的：两者并列时处在先的那个
words.recall_hint: forma（最先的）+ -er → 两者中在先的那个

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ form（成形）+ -ance → 把一件事彻底做成形 → 当众做完的一场，及成效
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 parfourmance，来自 parfournir（彻底完成）← per＋fournir，后受 form 影响改拼
words.native_definition: an act of presenting a play or music before an audience; how well someone does something
words.core_concept: carrying a thing through until it stands fully formed – 把一件事一路做到彻底成形
words.core_image: 幕布拉开，她把整支曲子一气走完
examples: The evening performance starts at eight.
His performance at work has improved.
semantic_expansions: 表演/演出：当众把一件事彻底做成形的那一场
表现：把事做到什么成形程度，即成效
words.recall_hint: per-（彻底）+ form（成形）→ 彻底做成形的一场与其成效

words.root_logic: portus（港、门道）与 portare（运送）同族 → 货物由船转陆的那个口
words.origin: 拉丁语 portus（港口、门道），与 portare（运送）同族
words.native_definition: a town or place where ships load and unload
words.core_concept: the mouth where goods pass between ship and shore – 货物在船与岸之间过渡的那个口
words.core_image: 吊臂起落，成箱货物从船舷转到岸上
examples: The ship reached port before dawn.
Grain is shipped through this port.
semantic_expansions: 港口/口岸：货物在船与岸之间过渡的那个口
words.recall_hint: portus（港、门道）→ 货物由船转陆的那个口
